_about: What the issuers publish now: certifications, course certificates and badges in AI, data, cybersecurity, cloud and IT, from the tech giants and the certifying bodies. The registries (CareerOneStop, Credential Engine) lag the issuers by a year or more on AI credentials; this file closes that gap. kb/_build_it_ai_credential_catalog.py reads the verified rows. The industry-credential watch agent keeps it current (docs/reference/credential_watch_agent.md): it re-verifies rows, adds new credentials, and marks retirements. It never deletes a row -- a retired credential is still evidence a student holds.
_verified_by: The credential catalog session, 2026-09-30: research agents reading issuer pages and search results that quote them. Sam Lee asked for it: 'I am interested in all certs, but particularly emerging ones from the tech giants' and 'Not just certs, but courses that result in badges or certs as well.' Weekly watch run 2026-10-19: direct reads of learn.microsoft.com, aws.amazon.com and nvidia.com. Weekly watch run 2026-10-26: direct reads of learn.microsoft.com and claude.com. Nightly watch run 2026-11-05 (slice: Amazon Web Services, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Oracle): direct reads of learn.microsoft.com and its public catalog API, aws.amazon.com, docs.aws.amazon.com, cloud.google.com, grow.google, nvidia.com, cisco.com and oracle.com/education/certification; IBM's full Credly badge listing (169 badges, badges.json) read; every IBM AI certification on it is already a row. Nightly watch run 2026-11-07 (slice: EC-Council, GIAC, IAPP, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft): direct reads of eccouncil.org, giac.org, iapp.org, claude.com, cloud.google.com, grow.google, learn.microsoft.com and its public catalog API (every certification it lists is now a row, retired ones marked from Microsoft's own warnings), nvidia.com and cisco.com; openai.com, academy.openai.com, pearsonvue.com and anthropic-partners.skilljar.com did not resolve. Nightly watch run 2026-11-09 (slice: Databricks, Snowflake, CompTIA, ISC2, ISACA, Google, Microsoft): direct reads of databricks.com (catalog, seven certification pages and the Context Engineer exam guide), comptia.org (catalog and product pages), isc2.org, isaca.org, grow.google, cloud.google.com and learn.microsoft.com with its public catalog API; oracle.com and nvidia.com for the unverified rows. Nightly watch run 2026-11-10 (slice: EC-Council, GIAC, IAPP, Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Web Services, IBM): direct reads of eccouncil.org, giac.org, iapp.org, claude.com, aws.amazon.com (certification page, coming-soon page and the agentic microcredentials post) and IBM's Credly badge listing; learn.microsoft.com study guides, grow.google, coursera.org and cisco.com for skills; academy.claude.com, openai.com and blogs.oracle.com did not resolve.
_method_caveat: Most rows were confirmed from search results quoting the issuer's page. The environment's network policy blocked direct fetches of aws.amazon.com, docs.aws.amazon.com, learn.microsoft.com, grow.google, coursera.org, credly.com, comptia.org and nvidia.com on 2026-09-30, and the session's 200 web searches ran out before every row was re-checked. 'evidence' names what was seen. Confirm a row on the issuer's own page before a college relies on it; rows with verified=false are held out of the catalog until a run confirms them. 2026-10-12: Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, CompTIA and Credly pages now load directly; openai.com, anthropic.com and academy.claude.com do not resolve. 2026-11-02: www.ibm.com/training renders only in a browser, so IBM certifications were read from IBM's Credly listing and stay verified=false; skillbuilder.aws, blogs.oracle.com and blogs.cisco.com were refused by the network; education.oracle.com redirects to oracle.com, which loads. 2026-11-05: services.google.com (Google exam guide PDFs) and blogs.cisco.com do not resolve; www.oracle.com/education/certification returns 403 to WebFetch but loads with curl; education.oracle.com exam pages fail; netacad.com course pages render only in a browser; cloud.google.com/learn/certification renders no list, so Google Cloud certifications were read one page at a time. 2026-11-09: www.snowflake.com now answers 403 on every certification path tried, so Snowflake was not read; edge.sitecorecloud.io (ISC2 PDFs) does not resolve.
